verses.text: Mu gihe Abisirayeli baganzwa n’abacamanza, hateye inzara mu gihugu, maze umugabo umwe w’i Betelehemu mu karere ka Yuda, hamwe n’umugore wiwe n’abahungu biwe babiri, baja kuba baraba mu gihugu c’i Mowabu.
Uwo mugabo yitwa Elimeleki, umugore wiwe yitwa Nawomi, abahungu biwe na bo bitwa Mahiloni na Kiliyoni. Abo bari Abanyefurata baba i Betelehemu, mu karere ka Yuda. Nuko baja i Mowabu babayo.
Haheze igihe, Elimeleki, umugabo wa Nawomi, arapfa, Nawomi asigarana n’abahungu biwe babiri.
Mu nyuma abo bahungu barongora Abanyamowabukazi, umwe yitwa Orupa uwundi akitwa Rusi. Bamazeyo nk’imyaka icumi,
Mahiloni na Kiliyoni na bo nyene barapfa. Nawomi asigara wenyene abahungu biwe bompi n’umugabo wiwe bamaze gupfa.
Nawomi akiri i Mowabu yumva ko Uhoraho yatabaye abantu biwe akabarungikira ivyokurya. Nuko yitegura gusubira mu gihugu ciwe hamwe n’abakazana biwe.
Ava aho yaba ari kumwe n’abakazana biwe bafata inzira isubira mu karere ka Yuda.
Ariko Nawomi abwira abakazana biwe ati: “Nimwisubirire inyuma, umwe wese aje mu nzu kwa nyina. Uhoraho aze abagirire neza nk’uko mwatugiriye twe n’abahisi.
Uhoraho aze abahe impore mu ngo muzoja kwubakamwo.” Nuko arabagumbira arabasezera, bose bararira cane,
baca baramubwira bati: “Turajana nawe mu bwoko bw’iwanyu.”
Ariko Nawomi arababwira ati: “Nimwisubirire iwanyu, bakobwa banje. Ni igiki cotuma mujana nanje? Mbega nzosubira kuvyara abandi bahungu, ngo bababere abagabo?
Nimwitahire iwanyu, bakobwa banje; kuko ndashaje cane nta mugabo wundi nkironka. Naho nokwiyumvira ko ngifise ibindi vyizigiro vyo kuronka umugabo iri joro nyene nkavyara abahungu,
mbega mwobarindira gushika bakuze? Mworeka kurongorwa mubarindiriye? Oya ntivyokunda, bakobwa banje. Ivyanje ni umururazi kurusha ivyanyu, kuko Uhoraho ubwiwe yambanguriye ukuboko kwiwe!”
Bumvise ivyo bongera kurira cane. Maze Orupa agumbira inabukwe aramusezera, ariko Rusi amwumirako.
Nawomi abwira Rusi ati: “Raba mugenzawe arisubiriye mu b’iwabo no ku mana ziwe. Ehe jana na we.”

Ariko Rusi aramwishura ati: “Reka kunyingingira kuvana nawe canke gusubira inyuma ngo ndaguhebe. Aho uzoja ni ho nzoja, aho uzoba ni ho nzoba. Ihanga ryawe ni ryo rizoba ihanga ryanje kandi Imana yawe ni yo izoba Imana yanje.
Aho uzopfira ni ho nzopfira, kandi ni ho bazompamba. Uhoraho aze abimpanire, mbere birushirije, nihagira ikintandukanya na wewe atari urupfu.”
Nawomi amaze kubona ko Rusi yafashe ingingo ntabanduka yo kujana na we, ntiyasubira kumwinginga.
Abo bagore uko ari babiri baragenda gushika bashitse i Betelehemu. Bahashitse, abo mu gisagara bose bazira rimwe kubaraba. Abagore baho baravuga bati: “Mbega uwu si Nawomi?”
Na we arababwira ati: “Ntimunyite Nawomi, munyite Mara, kuko Iyishoboravyose yahinduye ubuzima bwanje umururazi ukomeye.
Nkigenda nta co nari nkenye, ariko Uhoraho angarukanye ata kintu na kimwe mfise. None ni igiki cotuma munyita Nawomi? Uhoraho yanteje amagorwa; Iyishoboravyose yanteje ivyago.”
Nuko Nawomi agaruka avuye i Mowabu ari kumwe n’umukazana wiwe Rusi, Umunyamowabukazi, bashika i Betelehemu mu gihe iyimbura ry’ingano ryari ritanguye.

headings.text: Rusi afata ingingo yo kugumana na Nawomi

verses.text: Nawomi yari afise incuti ku ruhande rw’umugabo wiwe, umugabo yari atunze kandi w’umwubahwa wo mu muryango wa Elimeleki, yitwa Bowazi.
Umusi umwe Rusi wa Munyamowabukazi abwira Nawomi ati: “Nyemerera nje mu mirima ntoratore ingano zakorotse inyuma y’umuntu wese aza kundaba ijisho ryiza.” Nawomi aramubwira ati: “Genda mwana wanje.”
Nuko aragenda atangura gutoratora ingano zasigaye mu mirima inyuma y’abimbuzi. Maze birahurirana asanga ariko atoratora mu murima wa Bowazi, wo mu muryango wa Elimeleki.
Maze Bowazi aca arashika avuye i Betelehemu, aramutsa abimbuzi ati: “ Uhoraho abane namwe!” Baramwishura bati: “ Uhoraho aguhe umugisha!”
Bowazi abaza umukozi yari ajejwe abimbuzi ati: “Urya mukobwa ni uwa nde?”
Uwo mukozi aramwishura ati: “Ni wa Munyamowabukazi yazanana na Nawomi bavuye i Mowabu.

Yaje asaba ati: ‘Ndabinginze mundeke ntoratore utwasigaye hagati y’imikama inyuma y’abimbuzi.’ Yaje mu murima kuva mu gitondo kandi gushika n’ubu ntarahagarika gukora, uretse akanya gato yicaye mu gitutu ngo aruhuke.”
Nuko Bowazi abwira Rusi ati: “Mukobwa wanje, nyumviriza. Ntuze uje gutoratora ingano mu wundi murima kandi ntuze uje kure y’aha. Uze ugumane n’abakobwa bankorera.

Uze urabe umurima abimbuzi banje bariko barimburamwo, hanyuma ugende ukurikira abakobwa bankorera. Nihanije abakozi ngo ntihagire uwugukorako. Kandi unyotewe, uzoce ugenda wihe amazi yo kunywa ku mibindi abakozi bavomye.”
Amubwiye ivyo, Rusi aca aramwunamira, amubwira ati: “Ni igiki gitumye ngirirwa ubuntu imbere yawe ngo unyiteho, jewe umunyamahangakazi?”
Bowazi aramwishura ati: “Barambwiye ivyo wakoreye nyokobukwe vyose kuva umugabo wawe apfuye, ko wahevye so na nyoko n’igihugu c’amavukiro ukaza kuba mu bantu utigeze umenya.
Uhoraho , Imana ya Isirayeli, uwo waje guhungira musi y’amababa, aze aguhembere ivyo wakoze. Uhoraho aze akwishure birushirije.”

Rusi aramubwira ati: “Icompa ngashishikara kugirirwa ubuntu imbere yawe, Nyakwubahwa. Urandemesheje kandi umbwiye amajambo meza jewe umusavyikazi wawe, naho ntari mpwanye n’umwe mu bakobwa bagukorera.”
Hageze gufungura, Bowazi aramubwira ati: “Ingo hano. Niwakire umukate ukoze mu muvinyu w’inkarisha.” Maze yicaye hamwe n’abimbuzi, amuha intete zikaranze. Ararya arahaga kandi aranasigaza.
Ahagurutse ngo atoratore ingano zakorotse, Bowazi ategeka abimbuzi biwe ati: “Naho yotoratora hagati y’imikama, ntimumugore.
Ahubwo, muze murakororera hasi ingano zimwe kugira ngo azitoratore, kandi ntimumukarire.”
Nuko Rusi atorora ingano muri uwo murima gushika ku mugoroba. Asekuye izo yegeranije, akwiza ingero efa.
Araheza azijana mu gisagara, maze inabukwe abona ingene yegeranije ingano nyinshi. Kandi Rusi arongera asokorora ivyo yari yashigaje ahejeje gufungura agahaga, arabimuha.

Inabukwe aramubaza ati: “Mbega watoratoye he uwu musi? Wakoreye he? Uwo mugabo yakwitayeho aragahezagirwa!” Maze Rusi abwira inabukwe nyene aho hantu yakoreye. Aravuga ati: “Izina ry’uwo mugabo nyene umurima nakoreyemwo uno musi ni Bowazi.”
Nawomi abwira umukazana wiwe ati: “ Uhoraho amuhezagire. Ntiyigeze ahagarika kugirira neza twebwe abazima n’abahisi.” Arongerako ati: “Urya mugabo ni incuti yacu ya hafi; ni umwe mu bacunguzi bacu.”
Maze Rusi Umunyamowabukazi aravuga ati: “Kandi yambwiye ngo: ‘Uze ugumane n’abakozi banje kugeza bahejeje kwegeranya umwimbu wanje wose.’ ”
Nawomi abwira Rusi umukazana wiwe ati: “Bizokubera vyiza, mukobwa wanje, kujana n’abakobwa bamukorera, kuko ugiye mu murima w’uwundi muntu wohava ugira ingorane.”
Nuko Rusi aguma hafi y’abakobwa bakorera Bowazi atorora gushika iyimbura rya sayiri n’ingano rirangiye. Kandi ico gihe yabana na inabukwe.
Umusi umwe Nawomi, inabukwe wa Rusi, aramubwira ati: “Mukobwa wanje, ntegerezwa kukuronderera urugo, ahantu uzoshobora kuronka ibigutunga.
Bowazi, shebuja wa barya bakobwa mwakorana, ni umucunguzi wacu. Muri iri joro ahava aja kugosoza sayiri ku mbuga yo kugosorerako.
Niwiyuhagire maze wisige, uheze wambare agahuzu keza kurusha izindi. Maze umanuke ku mbuga, ariko ntamenye ko ari ho uri kugeza ahejeje kurya no kunywa.
Niyaryama, urabe neza ahantu aryamye. Hanyuma uce ugenda umupfukure ibirenge vyiwe uce uryama. Azoheza akubwire ico ukwiye gukora.”
Rusi arishura ati: “Ndakora ivyo umbwiye vyose.”
Nuko aramanuka aja ku mbuga yo kugosorerako akora ivyo inabukwe yamubwiye gukora vyose.
Maze Bowazi ahejeje kurya no kunywa ahaze, aca aja kuryama i ruhande y’ikigunguzi c’imikama ya sayiri. Rusi aramwegera mu gacerere, apfukura ibirenge vyiwe araryama.
Ijoro rigeze hagati, sinzi icakomye uwo mugabo, arihindukiza maze asanga hari umugore aryamye ku birenge vyiwe.
Arabaza ati: “Uri nde?” Aravuga ati: “Ndi umuguranokazi wawe Rusi. Numpfuke igice co hepfo c’impuzu yawe, kuko uri umucunguzi w’umuryango wanje.”
Arishura ati: “ Uhoraho aguhezagire, mukobwa wanje. Ugize neza gusumba n’ubwa mbere: ntiwakurikiye abagabo bakiri bato, baba abatunze canke abakenye.
None rero, mukobwa wanje, ntutinye. Nzokora ivyo wasavye vyose. Abagabo bagenzanje bo mu gisagara bose barazi ko uri umugore w’imico myiza.
Naho vy’ukuri ndi umucunguzi, hari umucunguzi andusha kuba uwa hafi.
Guma ngaha iri joro, maze mu gitondo niyashima kugucungura, bizoba ari vyiza; azogucungura. Ariko niyo atabishima, ndahiye uguhoraho kw’ Uhoraho jewe nzobikora. Ryama ngaha gushika mu gitondo.”

Nuko aca aryama hafi y’ibirenge vyiwe gushika mu gitondo ca kare hatarabona neza, ata muntu yoshobora kumenya uwundi; maze Bowazi aramubwira ati: “Ntihaze hagire uwumenya ko hari umugore yaje ku mbuga yo kugosorerako.”
Arongera aramubwira ati: “Tega uwo mwitero wambaye uwugumye.” Rusi abigira nk’uko amubwiye, maze asukamwo ingero zitandatu za sayiri aramukorera. Aca asubira mu gisagara.
Rusi ashitse aho inabukwe ari, Nawomi aramubaza ati: “Vyagenze gute, ga mukobwa wanje?” Nuko Rusi amudondera ivyo Bowazi yamukoreye vyose
kandi arongerako ati: “Yampaye izi ngero zitandatu za sayiri, arambwira ati: ‘Ntuje kwa nyokobukwe iminwe misa.’ ”
Maze Nawomi aravuga ati: “Rindira, mukobwa wanje, gushika aho umenyera iyo biherera. Kuko uwo mugabo ataza kuruhuka adatunganije iki kibazo uwu musi.”

headings.text: Rusi na Bowazi ku mbuga yo kugosorerako

verses.text: Mu nyuma, Bowazi aduga kw’irembo ry’igisagara yicaraho. Wa mucunguzi yari yavuze ahaciye, Bowazi aravuga ati: “Ingo, mugenzi, wicare hano.” Nuko aragenda aricara.
Bowazi aca ahamagara icumi mu bakuru b’igisagara aravuga ati: “Nimwicare hano,” na bo baricara.
Maze abwira wa mucunguzi ati: “Nawomi, umwe yagaruka avuye i Mowabu, ariko aragurisha igice c’itongo ryari irya mwenewacu Elimeleki.

Niyumviriye kubikumenyesha kugira ngo urigure imbere y’aba bicaye hano n’imbere y’aba bakuru b’ubwoko bwacu. Niwaba ushaka kuricungura, ubikore. Ariko niwaba udashaka, ubimbwire, ndabimenye. Kuko ata n’umwe afise uburenganzira bwo kubikora atari wewe, jewe nza inyuma yawe.” Na we avuga ati: “Nzoricungura.”
Bowazi na we aravuga ati: “Ku musi uzogurirako iryo tongo rya Nawomi, uzoca utwara na Rusi wa Munyamowabukazi, umupfakazi w’umuhisi, kugira ngo tuzigame izina ry’umuhisi n’itongo ryiwe.”
Yumvise ivyo, wa mucunguzi aravuga ati: “Aho rero sinshobora kuricungura kuko vyohava bintera ingorane ku bw’itongo ryanje bwite. Ba ari wewe uricungura. Jewe sinshobora kubikora.”

Muri ico gihe muri Isirayeli, kugira ngo umuntu yerekane ko ahaye uwundi uburenganzira bwo gucungura canke kugura, yakura ikirato ciwe akagiha uwo wundi. Ico ni co cemeza ku mugaragaro ukwo gutanga uburenganzira.
Nuko wa mucunguzi abwira Bowazi ati: “Nabe ari wewe urigura.” Akura ikirato ciwe.
Maze Bowazi abwira ba bakuru n’abantu bose bari aho ati: “Uno musi mubaye ivyabona ko nguze na Nawomi itongo rya Elimeleki, Kiliyoni na Mahiloni.

Kandi nakiriye na Rusi Umunyamowabukazi, umupfakazi wa Mahiloni, nk’umugore wanje, kugira ngo mponore izina ry’uwapfuye n’itongo ryiwe, izina ryiwe ntirizimangane mu muryango wiwe canke mu gisagara avukamwo. Uwu musi mubaye ivyabona!”

Nuko ba bakuru n’abari kw’irembo baravuga bati: “Turi ivyabona. Uhoraho aze agire uwo mugore aje mu nzu yawe nka Rasheli na Leya, abo imiryango yose ya Isirayeli yakomotseko. Uze ugire igihagararo muri Efurata ube rurangiranwa i Betelehemu.
Umuryango wawe uzobe nk’uwa Perezi, uwo Yuda yavyaye kuri Tamari, biciye mu ruvyaro Uhoraho azoguha kuri uwu mugore akiri muto.”
Nuko Bowazi atwara Rusi, aba umugore wiwe. Maze aryamana na we, Uhoraho amuha gusama inda, avyara umwana w’umuhungu.
Abagore babwira Nawomi bati: “ Uhoraho ahimbazwe, atakuretse ngo ubure uwo kugucungura uwu musi. Izina ry’uwu mwana rize ribe rurangiranwa muri Isirayeli!
Azotuma ubuzima bwawe butotahara kandi agushigikire ugeze mu zabukuru. Kuko umukazana wawe, umwe agukunda kandi akurutira abahungu indwi, ari we yamuvyaye.”
Maze Nawomi atora wa mwana, aramukikira amushira mu gikiriza, aba ari we amurera.
Abagore babana na we baravuga bati: “Nawomi yaronse umuhungu.” Nuko bamwita Obedi. Ni we yabaye se wa Isayi, Isayi se wa Dawidi.
Uwu, rero, ni wo muryango wa Perezi: Perezi yavyaye Hezironi,
Hezironi avyara Ramu, Ramu avyara Aminadabu,
Aminadabu avyara Nahashoni, Nahashoni avyara Salumoni,
Salumoni avyara Bowazi, Bowazi avyara Obedi,
Obedi avyara Isayi, Isayi na we avyara Dawidi.

headings.text: Urutonde rwa ba sekuruza ba Dawidi
